description: Exchange loyalty points for a reward. This spends points: confirm the reward and its cost with the user and set confirm to true only after explicit agreement. Physical rewards need a shipping address.

city.description: City for shipping a physical reward.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user explicitly confirmed this action.

countryCode.description: Shipping country as a two-letter ISO code.

fullName.description: Recipient name for shipping a physical reward.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key of 8 to 100 characters that you generate once per attempt. Repeating it never creates a duplicate.

phone.description: Phone number without the country prefix.

postalCode.description: Postal code for shipping a physical reward.

street.description: Street and number for shipping a physical reward.
